section_path: Scrotum (excluding Malignant Melanoma, Merkel Cell Carcinoma, Kaposi Sarcoma, Mycosis Fungoides, Sezary Disease, and Other Lymphomas)
text:
C632  Scrotum, NOS

**Note 1:** This schema is based on the UICC chapter *Carcinoma of Skin,* pages 165-168.

**Note 2:** The following are not included in this schema
* Melanoma (M-8720-8790) of scrotum is included in the Melanoma schema
* Merkel cell carcinoma (M-8247) of the scrotum is included in the Merkel Cell Scrotum schema
* Mycosis Fungoides (M-9700) or Sezary disease (M-9701) of scrotum is included in the Mycosis Fungoides schema
* Kaposi sarcoma (M-9140) of the scrotum is included in the Kaposi Sarcoma schema
* Lymphoma of the scrotum is included in the Lymphoma schema

**Note 3:** In addition to directly assigning TNM, Summary Stage 2000 (SS2000) must be captured.  If directly assigning SS2000, use the *Skin Except Eyelid* chapter on page 172 of the [SS2000 on-line manual](https://seer.cancer.gov/tools/ssm/ssm2000/SSSM2000-122012.pdf#page=172).
